title: MILO Marathon 2026 Urdaneta Leg Review: Racing in Pangasinan's Third City
seo_title: MILO Marathon Urdaneta Leg 2026 Review | Pangasinan
meta_description: MILO Marathon 2026 Urdaneta Leg review: November 8 -- part of the 50th-anniversary Golden Run series in Pangasinan's third-largest city.
dek: Set for 8 November 2026, this Urdaneta leg brings the MILO Marathon's Golden Run series to Pangasinan's third most populous city, named after the pioneering 16th-century navigator Andres de Urdaneta.
verdict: The Urdaneta leg gives the MILO Marathon's 50th-anniversary Golden Run series a stop in Pangasinan's third-largest local government unit, a city founded in 1858 and named after Andres de Urdaneta -- the Spanish navigator credited with discovering the Pacific return route from the Philippines to Mexico. Five distances from 1K to 21K keep it broadly accessible. With over 145,000 residents, Urdaneta offers genuine mid-sized city infrastructure, though registration status wasn't yet confirmed open at the time of this research.

sections.heading: One of 15 Legs in the Golden Run
paragraphs: The Urdaneta leg offers 1K, 3K, 5K, 10K and 21.1K distances, part of the MILO Marathon's 50th-anniversary 'Golden Run' series -- 15 regional legs nationwide ahead of the National Finals in Clark City, Pampanga. [1] That anniversary framing gives every 2026 leg, including Urdaneta's, more institutional weight than a routine annual stop.

sections.heading: Named After a Pioneering Navigator
paragraphs: Urdaneta City was founded on 8 January 1858 and named after Andres de Urdaneta, the Spanish Augustinian friar and navigator best known for discovering the tornaviaje -- the return sailing route across the Pacific from the Philippines to Mexico -- a discovery that shaped centuries of transpacific trade. [2] The city attained cityhood in 1998 and has 34 barangays across its territory.

sections.heading: Pangasinan's Third City
paragraphs: Urdaneta is a component city in Pangasinan province, with a 2024 census population of 145,935 -- the third most populous local government unit in both Pangasinan and the entire Ilocos Region. [2] That gives the leg genuine mid-sized city infrastructure, including SM City Urdaneta Central and Urdaneta City University, without the logistics squeeze of a small provincial town.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Confirmed
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status for the Urdaneta leg has not been confirmed open. [1] Prospective participants should check the official MILO site directly for updates before booking travel around the 8 November 2026 race date.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
